blurb: Guests enter themed puzzle rooms and have 60 minutes to solve puzzles and escape. Each team has three clues they can use with a game master. The experience is suitable for families, friends, and corporate teams.
extraNote: All ticket sales are final; no refunds · Rescheduling only allowed if store is closed due to inclement weather · Arrive 10-15 minutes early; late arrivals may lose game time · Inclement weather closures follow local school closures; refunds or rescheduling offered · No alcohol allowed; staff may refuse service to intoxicated guests with no refund · Enter through the large glass-walled main lobby at the first suite with a large sign above red double doors on Federal Rd, opposite ShopRite grocery store.
